Author: Rose
Name: Olympus
Punchline: Intelligent rotation assistant for all combat jobs
Description: Olympus: An intelligent rotation assistant supporting all 21 combat jobs with healing, damage, mitigation, burst windows, party coordination, and timeline-aware fight predictions.

Author: RoseOfficial
Name: Komos
Punchline: Keep festival scenery around all year.
Description: Client-side festival control: pick which seasonal event scenery stays active in each zone, keep events after they end, and share scene presets.
Changelog:
### Fixed
- The event extender offers to keep an ended event only in zones that hold its scenery, and each such zone gets its own offer; before, whichever zone you stood in consumed the only offer, even with nothing there to keep
- A queued scenery change that the game applied late, after Komos had stopped waiting for it, is no longer mistaken for server scenery, so disabling Komos restores the real server state in that case too

### New
- Keep and Dismiss buttons in the window for ended events; the chat command still works
- Zone names in the window and in chat replies instead of bare territory numbers
- The installer listing now carries the release notes and a category

Author: RoseOfficial
Name: Moirai
Description: Automated FATE farming with a pure, unit-tested decision core: picks the best FATE in the zone, travels there, syncs, fights it to completion, handles collect and escort FATEs, and recovers from death and stuck states.

Author: RoseOfficial
Name: Mnemosyne
Punchline: Remembers what every character has done, so you don't have to.
Description: A progress checklist for all your characters. Each character appears after you log into it once with the plugin running: its story, jobs, events, dailies and weeklies, content, collections and money, and your own tasks. See what is left on every character in one list, compare them side by side, add up their gil and currencies with gil over time, and give each character a role that decides what counts for it. Mnemosyne stores character data only on this PC. It is never uploaded anywhere. It reads the game and never writes to it; its optional switch button asks Lifestream to change character.
Changelog:
### New — First Public Release
- One window for all your characters: every character down the left, one character's checklist on the right. A character appears after you log into it once with Mnemosyne running
- Seven categories read from the game (story, jobs, events, dailies and weeklies, content, collections, money) and My tasks, the tasks you add yourself
- All tasks: everything still to do on any character in one list, with pin, priority, snooze until the next reset, and hide
- All characters: a sortable table of every character, with gil, ventures ready, bag space and company seals
- Totals: each currency added up across your characters, and a graph of your gil over time
- Roles: give a character a role, such as a retainer mule, and only what the role tracks counts toward its number
- One chat line at login and a count in the server info bar; optional reminders for the daily reset, events ending, Wondrous Tails, house visits and My tasks before reset
- Export and import, to move your characters to another PC or keep a copy
- An optional button that switches to a character through Lifestream
- Nothing leaves your PC: Mnemosyne has no network code, does not use the Lodestone, and never writes to the game
